arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo STAGING_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=BEGIN
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCT=le001_1789265592
test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"
sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD | sed 's/^/LIVE_SHA=/'
sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD | sed 's/^/LIVE_BRANCH=/' || true
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)" && echo LIVE_WORKTREE=CLEAN
sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" remote -v | sed -E 's#://[^ @]+@#://[REDACTED]@#g' | head -2
for u in lowcost-europa.service lowcost-europa-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup-health.service; do
 echo "UNIT=$u"
 systemctl show "$u" -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ExecMainExitTimestamp -p ActiveState | grep -E '^(Result|ExecMainStatus|ExecMainExitTimestamp|ActiveState)=' || true
done
echo "ENV_CONFIG_PRESENT=$(test -f /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ENV_CONFIG_BACKUP_CAN_WRITE=$(sudo -n test -w /etc/lowcost-europa && echo yes || echo no)"
echo STAGING_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=END
